title: Emmy Noether: Modern LaTeX Working Corpus and Multilingual Translation Drafts (R804 Integrated Source-Control Head)
description:
This is the reader-facing Emmy Noether working record for the Modern LaTeX Editions of Mathematics Manuscripts project. This July 7, 2026 update keeps the compact reader-first layout and adds one current-head package: 07_Noether_Current_SourceControl_Integrated_v11_R800_R804_20260707.zip.

Open first: 00_Noether_German_Cumulative_Working_SourceControl_R796_20260705.pdf, 01_Noether_English_Cumulative_Working_Reader_RA10_20260612.pdf, and 02_Noether_Standalone_English_Papers_01_43_WorkingDrafts_20260706.zip. For the current German/source-control head after the WebB R800-R804 integration, use 07_Noether_Current_SourceControl_Integrated_v11_R800_R804_20260707.zip; inside it the current files are 1/01_current/cum_de_R804_integrated_v11.tex and 1/01_current/cum_de_R804_integrated_v11.pdf.

New v11 scope: v11 integrates source-backed changes from R800-R804: Paper 34 formula-numbering/arrow/spacing and relation-ideal fixes including the carried R799 p684 correction; Paper 40 whole-paper current-head closure with no TeX delta; Paper 14 dense-locus and hazard checks; and Paper 19 p57 varrho-family repair. The v11 package includes the LocalCodex v10-to-v11 diff, copied WebB R800-R804 ledgers/diffs, compile logs, and updated correction/page-QC/hard-math ledgers.

Earlier July 7 rollup: 06a, 06b, and 06c preserve the organized R787-R804 source-repair/audit packets; 06d is an auxiliary OCR-locator companion. Local intake gaps remain explicit: R790 and R799 standalone ZIPs were not found in the swept Noether folder, although later cumulative material carries the R799 p684 correction into v11.

Status: this is a serious source-repair and translation working corpus, not OCR-only, but it is not a critical edition and not a globally certified final Noether corpus. File names inside inherited packets may include COMPLETE; that word indicates that a web-session packet completed its local task, not that the Noether corpus or the relevant paper is certified complete. Dense formulas, tables, scan-difficult passages, and language branches still require source checking. The German/source-control branch remains the authority for downstream translations.

Older granular repair packets remain preserved in previous Zenodo versions. Corrections can be proposed through the GitHub mirror: https://github.com/KokunoYumeto/modern-latex-manuscripts.
notes: Reader-first public surface with R804 integrated v11 current-head package. Not a critical edition, not a global source-faithfulness certification, and not a complete multilingual synchronization.
